item.title: UGent VPN from Ubuntu with open source software
item.description: Ghent University uses Cisco AnyConnect VPN and recommends the proprietary “Cisco Secure Client”. While I’m happy there is an actual supported option for Linux users, I’d rather not have more proprietary software on my machine, so I looked for alternative ways to connect.
